class.name: BattleBox
class.brief_description: [color=red](Not user creatable)[/color] A node that serves as the player's space in battle and as the player's menu.
class.description:
[BattleBox] is a node that serves as both the space where the player is located during battle and as the player's menu. It plays a central role in battle, managing the player's selection UI and interactions. It also functions as the player's space in battle, providing various battle effects such as changing the box's size and position, polygon mode, and web line generation.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: get_size
method.description: Returns the current size of the box.

method.name: get_box_position
method.description: Returns the current position of the box.

method.name: get_box_rotation
method.description: Returns the current rotation value of the box.

method.name: reset_box
method.description: Resets the box's size, position, and rotation to their initial values. [param duration] sets the time it takes to reset.

method.name: change_size
method.description: Changes the size of the box. [param new_size] is the new size. If [param relative] is true, [param new_size] is treated as a relative size added to the current size. [param duration] sets the time it takes for the size to change.

method.name: change_position
method.description: Changes the position of the box. [param new_position] is the new position. If [param relative] is true, [param new_position] is treated as a relative position added to the current position. [param duration] sets the time it takes for the position to change.

method.name: advanced_change_size
method.description: An advanced function that changes the position and size of the box simultaneously. [param relative_to] sets the reference point by which position and size are changed. [param new_position] is the new position. [param new_size] is the new size. If [param position_relative] is true, [param new_position] is treated as a relative position added to the current position. If [param size_relative] is true, [param new_size] is treated as a relative size added to the current size. [param duration] sets the time it takes for the position and size to change.

method.name: advanced_set_size
method.description: An advanced function that changes the position and size of the box simultaneously. Unlike [method advanced_change_size], this function applies the changes immediately without any transition effect. [param relative_to] sets the reference point by which position and size are changed. [param new_position] is the new position. [param new_size] is the new size. If [param position_relative] is true, [param new_position] is treated as a relative position added to the current position. If [param size_relative] is true, [param new_size] is treated as a relative size added to the current size.

method.name: rotate_by
method.description: Rotates the box. [param rot] is the rotation value (unit: degrees). If [param relative] is true, [param rot] is treated as a relative rotation added to the current rotation. [param duration] sets the time it takes to rotate.

method.name: set_box_rotation
method.description: Sets the rotation of the box. Unlike [method rotate_by], this function applies the rotation immediately without any transition effect. [param rot] is the rotation value (unit: degrees). If [param relative] is true, [param rot] is treated as a relative rotation added to the current rotation.

method.name: box_show
method.description: Makes the battle box visible.

method.name: box_hide
method.description: Hides the battle box.

method.name: clear_webs
method.description: Removes all purple lines (webs) created by [method set_webs]. Use this function to clear or remove all purple lines.

method.name: set_webs
method.description:
A function that sets up the purple lines (webs) required before using [constant SoulBattle.PURPLE] mode. Use this function to adjust the number, spacing, and margin of the purple lines.
[param n] is the number of purple lines. Setting it to 0 prevents any purple lines from being created. [param separation] is the spacing between purple lines. Setting it to a negative value causes the spacing to be adjusted automatically. [param margin] is the margin between the purple lines and the battle box. Setting it to a positive value adds a margin.

method.name: get_web_y_pos
method.description: Returns the y coordinate of a purple line (web) created by [method set_webs]. [param id] is the index of the purple line, starting from 0. For example, if [param id] is 0, the y coordinate of the first purple line is returned.

method.name: blitter_print
method.description: This function is used to display text during the player's turn, not the enemy's turn. [param texts] is an array of texts to display.

method.name: polygon_enable
method.description: Enables polygon mode for the battle box. In polygon mode, the battle box can take on a polygonal shape.

method.name: polygon_disable
method.description: Disables polygon mode for the battle box and restores it to its original rectangular shape. [param box_size] is used to set the size of the battle box when polygon mode is disabled. [param duration] is used to set the time it takes to disable polygon mode.

method.name: polygon_is_enabled
method.description: Returns whether polygon mode is enabled for the battle box. Returns true if polygon mode is enabled, false otherwise.

method.name: create_protrusion
method.description:
A function that creates a protrusion from the battle box. A protrusion is a box-shaped part that sticks out from the battle box. This function can be used after enabling polygon mode with [method polygon_enable].
[param direction] is used to set which face the protrusion extends from. For example, (1, 0) creates a protrusion from the right face, and (0, -1) from the top face. [param offset] is used to set the position of the protrusion. [param size] is used to set the size of the protrusion. [param duration] is used to set the time it takes to create the protrusion.

method.name: get_polygon_points
method.description: Returns all points of the current polygon in polygon mode.

method.name: get_vertex_position
method.description: Returns the position of the vertex at the specified index in polygon mode.

method.name: move_closest_point
method.description:
Finds the vertex closest to the target point and moves it there. This function can be used after enabling polygon mode with [method polygon_enable].
[param target_point] is the target point to move the vertex to. [param duration] is used to set the time it takes for the vertex to move. This function returns the index of the moved vertex.

method.name: move_point_by_index
method.description:
Moves the vertex at the specified index to the target point. This function can be used after enabling polygon mode with [method polygon_enable].
[param vertex_index] is the index of the vertex to move. [param target_point] is the target point to move the vertex to. [param duration] is used to set the time it takes for the vertex to move.

method.name: move_point_by_offset
method.description:
Finds the vertex closest to the specified point and moves it by the given offset. This function can be used after enabling polygon mode with [method polygon_enable].
[param from_point] is the reference point used to find the vertex to move. [param offset] is the offset by which to move the vertex. [param duration] is used to set the time it takes for the vertex to move. This function returns the index of the moved vertex.

method.name: move_multiple_points
method.description:
Moves multiple specified vertices to their target points. This function can be used after enabling polygon mode with [method polygon_enable].
[param vertex_indices] is an array of indices of the vertices to move. [param target_points] is an array of target points for each vertex. The order must match [param vertex_indices]. [param duration] is used to set the time it takes for the vertices to move.

method.name: stop_all_point_tweens
method.description: Immediately stops the tweens of all vertices currently moving in polygon mode. Use this function to forcibly stop all vertex movements.

members.member: Sets the text that appears when the battle is won.
Sets the easing type applied to box transition functions.
Sets the transition type applied to box transition functions.
Sets the speed at which vertices move in polygon mode. The unit is pixels per second.
Sets the number of vertices in polygon mode. A higher vertex count produces a smoother polygon shape, but may impact performance.

signal.name: moved_to_buttons
signal.description: Emitted when the player moves to the button selection state during the player's turn. [b]This signal is used internally by the engine.[/b]

signal.name: move_soul
signal.description: Emitted when the soul moves during the player's turn. [param newpos] is the position the soul will move to. [b]This signal is used internally by the engine.[/b]

signal.name: exit_menu
signal.description: Emitted when the player exits the menu during the player's turn. [b]This signal is used internally by the engine.[/b]

signal.name: act
signal.description: Emitted when a specific action is selected from the ACT menu during the player's turn. [param target] is the index of the target for the selected action. [param option] is the option index of the selected action. [b]This signal is used internally by the engine.[/b]

signal.name: fight
signal.description: Emitted when a specific target is selected from the FIGHT menu during the player's turn. [param target] is the index of the selected target. [b]This signal is used internally by the engine.[/b]

signal.name: item
signal.description: Emitted when a specific item is selected from the ITEM menu during the player's turn. [param item_choice] is the index of the selected item. [b]This signal is used internally by the engine.[/b]

signal.name: mercy
signal.description: Emitted when a specific option is selected from the MERCY menu during the player's turn. If [param target] is 0, "Mercy" was chosen; if 1, "Flee" was chosen. [b]This signal is used internally by the engine.[/b]

signal.name: tween_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the box transformation animation is complete.

signal.name: blitter_end
signal.description: Emitted when all text printed by the [method blitter_print] method has finished displaying.
